name: opsbrain
description: OpsBrain — AI 网络运维平台

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd web/frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run install:python && echo. && echo [OK] Dependencies installed. Run 'npm run dev' to start.
scripts.setup:win: npm run install:all && npm run install:python
